_doc: Per-board slot assignments. Each board has exactly 2 slots: index 0 → ota_0, index 1 → ota_1. 'name' is the OLED label and the --only key in flash_all.py. 'build' tells flash_all.py how to find the default firmware binary; override at flash time with --slot0 <path> / --slot1 <path>. Edit this file to swap firmwares between slots, rename, or point at custom builds — then rebuild and re-flash the selector for the new labels to appear.
